description: Expose workflow task required files for in-place issue review, add server-derived board stage progress, and classify task work so internal orchestration does not inflate user-facing progress.

tasks.title: Preserve task required-file metadata
tasks.description: Materialize files declared by workflow task `with.expect.files` into TaskRun metadata without storing file content. Preserve path, `task-expect` source, marker requirements when present, and an on-demand content availability signal across runtime status, output, attempt, artifact, and failure updates.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskRun state includes required-file metadata for each file declared in `with.expect.files`.
Required-file metadata survives task execution updates that change status, attempts, output, artifacts, or failure evidence.
No file content is stored in WorkflowRun or TaskRun state.
tasks.output: WorkflowRun/TaskRun domain model carries required file metadata without persisted content.
tasks.notes: Prefer a dedicated requiredFiles model over generic artifacts unless existing DTO constraints make artifacts the smaller compatible path.

tasks.title: Classify user-facing and orchestration tasks
tasks.description: Add task classification or visibility to materialized TaskRun state so projections can distinguish user-facing work from orchestration/internal workflow work. Assign conservative defaults for default workflow tasks, runtime-added orchestration, repair, retry, rebase, and dynamic Build sources.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskRun exposes a stable classification or visibility value for user-facing versus orchestration/internal work.
Known orchestration/internal task sources are marked so they can be excluded from user-facing progress counts.
Existing tasks without explicit classification remain compatible and do not break workflow execution.
tasks.output: TaskRun materialization and update paths expose task classification for projections.
tasks.notes: Do not infer classification from task title strings in Web UI.

tasks.title: Expose required files in workflow APIs
tasks.description: Project TaskRun required-file metadata into workflow timeline, stage-state, and WorkflowRun-backed task DTOs. Keep responses additive and metadata-only, and continue loading file content exclusively through the existing issue-scoped file-content endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow timeline task responses include required file entries for tasks with expected files.
Stage-state task responses include the same canonical required file entries without embedded file content.
Each projected required file includes path, source `task-expect`, content availability or fetchability, and marker requirements when declared.
tasks.output: Workflow timeline and stage-state API DTOs expose required file metadata.
tasks.notes: Reuse `/api/issues/{number}/workflow/file-content?path=...`; do not add a duplicate artifact-content endpoint unless the existing route cannot represent required states.

tasks.title: Add issue-list stage progress read model
tasks.description: Add `workflowStageProgress` to issue list items and derive it server-side from the current stage read model. Count only user-facing tasks, expose completed/total plus running, failed, and current task title when available, and omit or empty the value for non-meaningful states.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues` includes `workflowStageProgress` for active workflow stages with user-facing tasks.
Progress total, completed, running, and failed counts exclude orchestration/internal tasks.
Failed unsuperseded user-facing tasks are not counted as completed and can be exposed through a failed count.
Backlog, done, cancelled, no-user-task, and approval/check-only waiting states omit or return an empty progress value.
tasks.output: Issue list API returns compact server-derived current-stage user-task progress.
tasks.notes: Do not make board cards fetch per-issue workflow timelines to compute progress.

tasks.title: Cover backend projection and progress behavior
tasks.description: Add backend tests for expected-file projection, metadata preservation, task classification, and issue-list progress counting. Use fakes for any workspace/file availability checks so tests do not depend on real filesystem content.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify `with.expect.files` becomes TaskRun metadata and projects into timeline/stage-state DTOs.
Tests verify runtime task updates do not remove required-file metadata.
Tests verify issue-list progress counts only user-facing tasks and excludes internal orchestration tasks.
Tests verify failed unsuperseded tasks do not increment completed progress.
Filesystem or file-content availability behavior is tested through fakes, not real workspace files.
tasks.output: Backend regression tests for task required files, task classification, and stage progress summaries.
tasks.notes: Include both domain-level and projection/read-model tests where they provide different coverage.

tasks.title: Render required files on issue task rows
tasks.description: Update Web API types and workflow timeline/stage-state mappers so required-file metadata reaches Issue Detail. Render required files on or within their task rows as first-class review items while preserving the existing compact layout for tasks without required files.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail displays each required file path for tasks whose API data includes required files.
Required file entries indicate source `task-expect` and show marker requirements or unavailable/missing status when provided.
Tasks without required files do not render empty artifact chrome or lose the existing compact presentation.
tasks.output: Issue Detail task rows render task required-file review entries from API data.
tasks.notes: Keep this contextual artifact affordance separate from the dedicated Files changed review surface.

tasks.title: Add on-demand required-file viewer
tasks.description: Let users open a required file entry from Issue Detail and inspect its current scoped worktree content in place. Fetch content only after user interaction through the existing issue-scoped workflow file-content API and show clear unavailable states without changing task status.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a required file calls the issue-scoped file-content API with issue number and file path.
Returned content is rendered in an in-place panel or expandable viewer while the user remains on Issue Detail.
Missing, unavailable, or unreadable file responses show a clear viewer state and do not mark the workflow task failed.
Opening and closing the viewer does not persist file content into workflow domain state or Web read models.
tasks.output: Issue Detail supports on-demand task-required file content inspection.
tasks.notes: Use the existing scoped endpoint rather than adding a new file access path.

tasks.title: Render board card stage progress
tasks.description: Update Web issue-list types and board card rendering to consume `workflowStageProgress` from the list API. Show a compact fraction such as `3/7` for meaningful active stage progress and hide or de-emphasize it when the API omits or empties the value.
acceptanceCriteria: Board cards display compact progress for active issues with non-zero `workflowStageProgress.total`.
The displayed progress corresponds to the stage and counts returned by the server.
The card does not recompute progress from raw timeline task arrays or trigger per-card timeline requests.
Progress is hidden or visually de-emphasized for backlog, done, cancelled, no-user-task, and approval/check-only waiting states.
tasks.output: Board issue cards render compact server-derived workflow stage progress.
tasks.notes: Keep the indicator visually compact so it does not crowd card title, labels, or attention states.

tasks.title: Cover Web artifact and progress UI
tasks.description: Add Web regression tests for required file rendering, on-demand file viewer loading, unavailable content states, and board card progress rendering. Mock API responses and use fake file-content results so tests never require real filesystem access.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify required file entries are visible on Issue Detail task rows when API metadata is present.
Tests verify tasks without required files do not render empty artifact UI.
Tests verify selecting a required file calls the file-content API on demand with the issue number and path.
Tests verify unavailable file-content responses render a clear unavailable state.
Tests verify board cards display compact progress for active stages and hide or de-emphasize progress when no meaningful progress is reported.
tasks.output: Web UI regression tests for task artifact review and board stage progress.
tasks.notes: Use mocked network/API layers and fake content responses; do not read real workspace files.
